content.passage: A community learning centre has been offering evening courses for three years. Many adults have improved their skills, and some have found new jobs as a result. The centre used to run only one class each week, but it now offers several options. Next month, a new computer course is starting. If enough people apply, another group will be organised. All applications must be completed online, and students should receive confirmation within five working days. The coordinator said that anyone who needed help could contact the office.
